description: An advanced unilateral push up variation where one arm presses while the opposite arm extends out straight as a stabilizer.
setup: Get into a wide push up plank position on the floor with fingers pointed slightly outward.
steps: Lower your chest toward one hand while sliding the opposite arm straight out to the side.
Pause briefly with chest hovering just above your working hand.
Press strongly through the working palm to return back to the center plank.
cues: Keep your torso rigid without twisting your hips
Treat the straight arm as a kickstand for balance

mistakes.mistake: Hips rotating open toward the extended arm
mistakes.fix: Brace core and keep both hip bones square to the ground throughout the movement
Keep the non-working arm fully straight, resting on your palm or fingertips

rep_standard: Full lockout at center top, working chest hovers 1 inch off the ground at bottom
